bullets.text: In Uthukottai, heavy rain submerged 400 acres of paddy crops due to road work, and the office should inspect the affected farming areas.
Near Sholavaram in Thiruvallur district, two lorry drivers were detained for murdering a colleague, and the office must monitor the police investigation.
Water-filled potholes on Velachery Main Road near the Medavakkam flyover threaten motorists, requiring the office to urge immediate road repairs.
Passengers near Poonamallee protested after waiting two hours for a government bus, and the office should watch transport operations.
Three members of the same family passed away consecutively in Thiruvallur district, and the office should check on support for the relatives.
Scammers used AI technology to impersonate clothing brands in online fraud, prompting Chennai cybercrime police warnings that the office should track.
IT Secretary Atul Anand reported that Tamil Nadu fixed PHP vulnerabilities in 10 government websites, and the office should watch the remaining fixes.
